name: clauseway/product-tabs
title: Product tabs (Review, Redline, Compare, Approve)
description: A product panel with four tabs. Each tab plays its own scene: risk ring, redlines being typed, two versions compared, approvals stamped. Cycles by itself while on screen; a click picks a tab.

clauseList.default:
Payment | Medium
Liability | High
Indemnity | High
Termination | Medium
Confidentiality | Low
Data use | Low
Governing law | Low

reviewText.default: Provider's total liability for any claim under this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid by Customer in the twelve months before the claim.

reviewWhy.default: The cap is lower than the value of the work, and it applies to every kind of claim.

reviewAsk.default: A cap of two times the annual fees, with carve-outs for data loss and confidentiality.

redlineCurrent.default: Provider's total liability [[will not exceed the fees paid]] by Customer in the [[twelve months]] before the claim.

redlineSuggested.default: Provider's total liability will not exceed two times the fees paid by Customer in the twelve months before the claim, except for data loss and breach of confidentiality.
